RECEIPTOR AI | FOUNDING GROWTH LEAD | REMOTE | FULL-TIME

Receiptor AI is building agentic AI to make bookkeeping invisible. We are a team of 2 co-founders seeking a Founding Growth Lead to build our acquisition engine.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You are the first (growth) hire and will define the function from the ground up.

We seek a builder with deep expertise in growth. You should have a founder mindset and be ready to own the function.

Apply: Send CV and a short note on why you fit this role to info@receiptor.ai

More info: https://www.notion.so/receiptor-ai/Founding-Growth-Lead-2fb4...
